These fixtures replay recorded work results through Rust Accumulate in the PVM
and compare storage with Quint's expected states. They do not execute Rust Refine.

Regenerate the refine-error, skipped-work, empty-block, minimal, and stale-parent traces
using Python 3 and Quint 0.32.0 from the repository root:

```sh
python3 scripts/generate-quint-replays.py
cargo test -p parachain-service-bin --test quint_replay
```

The generator uses the pinned `vendor/polkadot-sdk-quint` model, TypeScript
backend, and seed 1. It writes deterministic compact JSON; other fixtures are
not regenerated by this script.

`blocks/work_error_between_candidates_works.itf.json` accepts a candidate,
skips a `WorkErr` block while preserving the accepted head and service state,
then accepts a candidate built on that head. Replay compares storage after
each block.

- `just quint-fmt` expands all fixtures in place for review.
- `just quint-compact` restores compact JSON before committing.

Replay supports at most one work result per block. Nonempty incoming transfers
are unsupported because the model and Rust use different bucket layouts.
Accumulate-log entries are unsupported. Returned head commitments and JAM
assignment/staging outputs are not compared.
